_comment: License (TRIAL_FIRST) client-software product. publish.mjs uploads `assets` first and injects their objectNames into baseInfo.coverImage / introduce.images / clientSoftware, then submits. Edit product fields; keep the pricing/edition rules in reference.md in mind.

baseInfo.summary: A license-gated desktop app that helps teams get work done faster with offline-first sync and a plugin ecosystem.

introduce.functions: Offline-first sync, command palette, plugin marketplace, cross-device clipboard, and granular license tiers.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Knowledge workers, indie hackers and small teams who want a fast, private productivity tool.
introduce.usageScenarios: Daily note-taking, task planning and team knowledge sharing across Windows machines.
introduce.painPoints: Existing tools are either cloud-only or lack fair trial + tiered licensing.
